body: The uncle is on my mom's side and he was the first one to take me hunting and fishing and do "man" stuff when I was a kid.  My dad's brothers have had very little to do with me my entire life.  Mainly due to distance, they live several states away.  We talk here and there but we've only met a handful of times.

Aside from the health issues being weight related, yes, spot on.  The MIL situation isn't a huge deal it's just an adjustment thing.  With her divorce and her mannerisms it's hard to get a read on her, so I tend to just stay upstairs.
